ru: Старательный найдёт — и в камень гвоздь вобьёт.
en: The diligent one finds — and even drives a nail into stone.
tr: Çalışan bulur, taşa bile çivi çakar.

tt: Җиде кат үлчә, бер кат кис.
ru: Семь раз отмерь, один раз отрежь.
meaning: Прежде чем что-то делать, хорошо подумай.
tr: Yedi kere ölç, bir kere biç.
meaning_tr: Bir işe başlamadan önce iyice düşün.

meaning: Маленькие, но постоянные усилия дают большой результат.
en: Drop by drop the stone is pierced.
meaning_en: Small but steady efforts bring great results.
meaning_tr: Küçük ama sürekli çabalar büyük sonuç verir.
meaning_fi: Pienet mutta sinnikkäät ponnistelut tuovat suuria tuloksia.

meaning: Спешка приводит к ошибкам (поспешишь — людей насмешишь).
en: The one in a hurry gets burned by the soup.

ru: Кто много читает, тот много знает.
meaning_en: Reading is the way to knowledge.
fi: Joka paljon lukee, se paljon tietää.

en: Knowledge is light, ignorance is darkness.
meaning_en: Learning lets you see the world clearly.

tt: Иске дус яңа ике дустан яхшырак.
en: An old friend is better than two new ones.
tr: Eski dost iki yeni dosttan iyidir.
fi: Vanha ystävä on parempi kuin kaksi uutta.

tt: Кош — канаты белән, кеше — дусты белән.
en: A bird is strong with its wings, a person with friends.
meaning_en: Friends are a person's main support.
fi: Lintu on vahva siivillään, ihminen ystävillään.

en: At the bottom of patience lies yellow gold.
A kind word is food for the soul.
meaning_en: A kind word heals and gladdens.

ru: Когда дело сделано, можно и поиграть.
meaning: Сначала работа, потом отдых (кончил дело — гуляй смело).
en: When the work is done, you may play.
fi: Kun työ on tehty, saa leikkiä.

en: Speech is silver, silence is gold.
meaning_en: Sometimes it is better to stay silent.

en: Even the soil of one's homeland heals.
If your neighbour is at peace, so are you.
meaning_en: Live in peace with your neighbours.
fi: Kun naapurisi on rauhassa, olet sinäkin.
